title: ASCEP Layer 3 — Serving configuration
description: Layer 3 of the five ASCEP layers. Declares framework, parallelism, batching and KV configuration. Topology binding (C3): every KV and throughput figure produced under this declaration is valid only at this tensor_parallel / pipeline_parallel / gpu_count triple.

framework.description: Serving framework name (e.g. vLLM, SGLang, TGI, TensorRT-LLM, or other). No default assumed.

framework_version.description: Exact framework version string. 'latest' is non-conforming (C8).

container_digest.description: Immutable container image digest (sha256). Required by the reproduction bundle (C8).

tensor_parallel.description: Tensor-parallel width. Per-GPU KV is NOT constant across widths (ascep.capacity.kv_heads_per_rank replicates heads once TP > n_kv_heads); all figures in the run layer MUST inherit this value (C3).

gpu_count.description: Devices in one replica = tensor_parallel * pipeline_parallel unless otherwise stated. Binds capacity figures (C3).

max_model_len.description: Framework maximum sequence length in tokens. A run above native_max_context_tokens without declaration invalidates context-bound throughput claims (C4).

max_model_len_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when max_model_len is null (C1).

memory_utilization.description: Framework's own memory cap (vLLM gpu_memory_utilization, SGLang mem_fraction_static, or equivalent), dimensionless in (0,1]. REQUIRED and never nullable: it is the most frequently omitted number in published benchmarks, and without it a KV measurement cannot be reproduced and analytic projections disagree with it by multiples. Input to ascep.capacity.kv_pool_bytes and calibration target of calibrate_memory_utilization.

batching_mode.description: Batching discipline. Static batching invalidates comparison against continuous-batching runs at the same concurrency.

max_num_seqs.description: Scheduler cap on concurrent sequences, if set. Units: sequences.

max_num_seqs_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when max_num_seqs is null (C1).

max_num_batched_tokens.description: Scheduler cap on batched tokens per step, if set. Units: tokens.

max_num_batched_tokens_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when max_num_batched_tokens is null (C1).

prefix_caching.description: Prefix cache state. An untracked prefix-cache hit inflates measured throughput and is a required explanation for any roofline_efficiency at or above 1.0.

kv_cache_offload.description: Whether KV is offloaded to host memory. If on, calibrate_memory_utilization may return an effective utilization above 1.0 — that is a flag, not a result.

kv_cache_quantized.description: Whether runtime KV quantization applies beyond model kv_precision.

speculative_decoding.description: Speculative decoding state; MUST be off for protocol-comparable ITL claims unless the draft configuration is fully declared.

engine_reported_kv_cache_tokens.description: KV cache size in tokens as reported by the engine at startup (M). THE number to trust: the protocol REQUIRES preferring it over the analytic memory model, and calibrate_memory_utilization SHOULD be used to reconcile before projecting to other context lengths. Units: tokens.

engine_reported_kv_cache_tokens_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when engine_reported_kv_cache_tokens is null (C1). Without it, every KV-floor figure in the report is (I) at best.

cold_start_to_ready_s.description: Measured seconds from process start to ready-to-serve (M). Units: seconds.

cold_start_to_ready_s_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when cold_start_to_ready_s is null (C1).

framework_version_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when framework_version is null (C1).

container_digest_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when container_digest is null (C1).

memory_utilization_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when memory_utilization is null (C1).

batching_mode_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when batching_mode is null (C1).

prefix_caching_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when prefix_caching is null (C1).

kv_cache_offload_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when kv_cache_offload is null (C1).

kv_cache_quantized_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when kv_cache_quantized is null (C1).

chunked_prefill_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when chunked_prefill is null (C1).

speculative_decoding_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when speculative_decoding is null (C1).
